origin: cwe/89/python Key Principles: dynamic identifiers are allowlisted, not escaped or parameterized

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The SQLAlchemy text query binds account_id and status, but the report sort key flows across three files into an interpolated ORDER BY clause.

trap: Adding a bound parameter for the ORDER BY identifier, escaping quotes in sort, or validating status while leaving sort raw. The sort value must select from a server-side map of allowed SQLAlchemy column expressions or fixed text fragments.
must_preserve: The account_id and status filters remain bound parameters, the default created_at sort remains available, and supported sort keys still work without accepting raw SQL fragments.
